# DzAsyncBoundary

`<Suspense>` wrapper that shows a loading fallback, catches the errors its subtree throws, and can time a pending child out.

- **Family:** Feedback
- **Source:** `packages/core/src/components/feedback/DzAsyncBoundary.vue` · types `packages/core/src/components/feedback/DzAsyncBoundary.types.ts`
- **Install:** `npm i @dzup-ui/core` — then `import { DzAsyncBoundary } from '@dzup-ui/core'`
- **Entry points:** `@dzup-ui/core`, `@dzup-ui/core/feedback`
- **Risk tier:** A · **Status:** stable

## Props (3)

| Prop | Type | Required | Declared default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `delay` | `number \| undefined` | no | `undefined` | Declared and accepted, but **not read by the component**: there is no code path in `DzAsyncBoundary.vue` that uses it, so setting it has no effect today. Owner decision D52 (TASK-R5-O8) settles whether to implement the intended "wait this long before showing the loading slot" behaviour or to withdraw the prop. |
| `onError` | `((err: unknown, instance: ComponentPublicInstance \| null, info: string) => void) \| undefined` | no | `undefined` | Called for every error the boundary catches — a rejected `<Suspense>` child (`info` is `"Suspense"`, `instance` is `null`) and a synchronous render error from any descendant. Optional; the boundary shows the `error` slot and stops propagation either way. |
| `timeout` | `number \| undefined` | no | `undefined` | Milliseconds to wait after the default slot suspends before emitting `timeout`. The timer is cleared when the child resolves. `undefined` (the default) never times out; the event is a notification only — nothing about the rendering changes when it fires. |

## Events (1)

| Event | Payload | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `timeout` | `[]` | Emitted once when the default slot has been suspended for `timeout` ms. Carries no payload and changes nothing on screen. |

## Slots (3)

| Slot | Slot props | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default` | — | The async content. Rendered inside `<Suspense>`; while it suspends the `loading` slot shows in its place. |
| `error` | `{ error: unknown; reset: () => void; }` | Replaces the content once an error is caught. Receives the error and a `reset` callback that clears it. |
| `loading` | — | Shown while the default slot is suspended. A `DzSpinner` when this slot is not filled. |

## Usage (from `packages/core/stories/feedback/DzAsyncBoundary.stories.ts`, story `Default`)
